title: eludite.project.set_property input
description: Change one project property, as the property pages' Save does: eludite-host edits the project file with MSBuild's construction model, changing exactly one element and keeping every other byte (formatting, comments, conditions). The condition rule: without `configuration`, `platform` and `framework` the unconditioned value is written (the first unconditioned property group); with them, the property group with that condition (Visual Studio's `'$(Configuration)|$(Platform)'=='Debug|AnyCPU'`, created when missing); a value equal to the default removes the element. `all_configurations` writes the unconditioned value and removes this property's conditioned elements. The inherited rule: a property inherited from Directory.Build.props (`source` inherited) is not written unless `override` is true; the answer says `inherited` with the file. When the file changes the solution reloads: the generation moves on and the Workspace, IntelliSense and builds see the change.

project.description: The project: its name as the Workspace window shows it, or the path of its project file (absolute, or relative to the solution folder). Default: the project selected in the Workspace window, else the active document's project, else the startup project.

value.description: The new value: text, true or false for a bool, null to remove the element (back to the default).

configuration.description: Write under this configuration's condition (a per-configuration property). Omitted: the unconditioned value.

platform.description: With `configuration`: the condition's platform (`AnyCPU`; `Any CPU` is read as `AnyCPU`). Omitted with `configuration`: the selection's platform for the project.

framework.description: A target framework of a multi-targeted project (`net8.0`). Default: none (the outer evaluation; for `set_property`, no framework condition).

all_configurations.description: All Configurations: write the unconditioned value and remove the conditioned ones for this property. Not with `configuration`.

override.description: Write an inherited property in the project anyway (the Override of the page's inherited banner).
